wait.line: Words, how little they mean when you're a little too late
stanza: Long handwritten note deep in your pocket
Words, how little they mean when you're a little too late
I stood right by the tracks, your face in a locket
Good girls, hopeful they'll be and long they will wait

partner.line: Good girls, hopeful they'll be and long they will wait

stanza: "No reason to get excited"
The thief, he kindly spoke
"There are many here among us
Who feel that life is but a joke
But you and I, we've been through that
And this is not our fate
So let us not talk falsely now
The hour is getting late"

partner.line: And this is not our fate
